headline: Recursive releases Flint, a coding model largely built by AI
summary: Startup Recursive released Flint, a free laptop-sized coding model it says was largely built by its own AI system, arguing the benefits of such AI self-improvement outweigh the risks.

claims.statement: Startup Recursive released a coding model called Flint that it says was largely built by its own AI.
